The official Tavily docs list a free tier, several monthly plans, and pay-as-you-go. Third-party sites disagree on plan names, so I'd rely on the docs.

**Official Tavily docs (most authoritative):** The free Researcher plan gives 1,000 credits a month with no card required. Monthly plans run from Project at $30 for 4,000 credits, to Bootstrap at $100 for 15,000, Startup at $220 for 38,000, and Growth at $500 for 100,000. Per-credit prices fall from $0.0075 to $0.005 across those tiers. Pay-as-you-go is $0.008 per credit, and Enterprise is custom. Pay-as-you-go allows you to be charged per credit once your plan's credit limit is reached.

**Credit costs:** A basic search is 1 credit, an advanced search 2 credits, and a deep Research request consumes a dynamic 4 to 250 credits depending on the model. Crawl costs depend on mapping plus extraction, and credits don't roll over monthly.

**Conflicts:** CostBench and ToolRadar list different tiers, such as "Researcher" at $30/month and "Startup" at $100/month. Their names and prices don't match the official docs, and CostBench's figures are dated June–August 2026. The official docs and the Tavily help-center pricing page (last updated May 2025) also differ in tier names, so check the live pricing page before relying on any single figure.

content.text:
At 38,000 credits a month, you'd be on the **Startup plan at $220/month**. That plan includes exactly 38,000 credits, which works out to about $0.0058 per credit.

- **If you go over:** Pay-as-you-go pricing is $0.008 per credit once you pass your plan's limit. Credits don't roll over from month to month.
- **Next tier up:** Growth is $500/month for 100,000 credits. It only makes sense above roughly 85,000 credits a month.
- **Credit usage:** A basic search costs 1 credit and an advanced search costs 2. A deep Research request costs between 4 and 250. If some of your 38,000 credits are advanced searches, that's fewer actual calls.

Third-party sites list different tier names and prices, and the Tavily help-center page is older and also differs. I used the official docs for the figures above. Check Tavily's live pricing page before you commit.

- [Tavily API credits docs](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-credits.md)
- [Tavily help center pricing](https://help.tavily.com/articles/8816424538-pricing)
- [Tavily docs: API credits guide](https://docs.tavily.com/guides/api-credits)
- [CostBench: Tavily plans](https://www.costbench.com/software/web-scraping/tavily/)
- [ToolRadar: Tavily pricing](https://toolradar.com/tools/tavily/pricing)
